Public intelligence — what it could establish Alphabet Inc. is a software platform business that runs on to our Google Cloud customers. The reading follows from how this kind of business works; 1 source(s) outside the company's control were read, which is not enough to size the effect, so it is held in direction only. 1 of the passages read came from a source the company does not control. Internal intelligence — what is still bounded These are the measures a business of this kind is judged on that the public record did not supply. Each one is a magnitude the analysis above had to leave in direction only. impressions or engaged time — the inventory being sold; without it there is nothing to auction. price per impression — the auction clearing price is the whole revenue line here. advertiser count and spend per advertiser — demand depth decides whether the auction clears at a good price. engagement per user — attention is the input to inventory, so it leads revenue. compute and infrastructure spend — recommendation quality is bought, and it is the largest cost line. regulatory and platform-policy exposure — targeting and data rules move revenue without any competitor acting. What impossible hypothesis should we tes.text: Home · Your analyses · Guest demo session Leave demo Alphabet Inc. What impossible hypothesis should we test? The workflow that Alphabet Inc.'s product sits inside may stop existing rather than be improved.: It sells to its Google Cloud customers. A product priced against a human process captures a share of that process's cost; when the process is performed by a machine end to end, the customer is no longer buying a better way to do it, and there is nothing left for the price to be a share of.; Alphabet Inc.'s most important competitor may be its own customers deciding to do this themselves.: It charges on consumption-based fees and subscriptions for infrastructure, platform, applications, and other cloud services. A charge that scales with the customer's own volume grows into a line item large enough to justify a build, and the largest customers reach that threshold first — which are the same accounts the revenue depends on most.; Within Google Services may be structurally unable to answer a move here, which would make the contested position far cheaper to take than a symmetric reading implies.: Within Google Services was established as a competitor from disclosure rather than assumed. A rival with an existing business to protect faces a cost in answering that a firm without one does not — the response damages revenue it already books, so the constraint is its own P&L rather
